reviews.author: Debbie Kenney
reviews.text: APL did a spectacular job on my back fence. I am just thrilled with the final result. Tony and his crew were very professional, cleaned up when done. Hard working young men. Highly recommend giving them a try.

reviews.author: Jonathan Glorioso
reviews.text: Tony and his crew are very professional. We have had multiple clean ups done by them, and we have loved every turn out. Tony and the crew take time to make sure everything looks perfect. Tony is very knowledgeable with all of his work. He recommended certain plants to us after we told him what we were looking for, and they couldn’t have been a better recommendation. Don’t hesitate to contact Tony!!

reviews.author: Dougy Squared
reviews.text: This spring clean-up I decided to try a new landscaper for a pair of rental properties I own. In previous years I had been disappointed with some of the bigger named companies around South Jersey. Much to my delight, APL landscaping came through and did far more than I ever asked for. Tony (I believe his name was) was out to the property the same day to provide me a great price. Two days later, both properties were beautiful and my tenants were thrilled. He was extremely prompt and very tidy. Huge thanks to APL for making this chore an easy one. I don’t usually like leaving reviews, but this small company earned my diligence.

reviews.author: Karen Hoffman
reviews.text: Tony and his crew have been doing my lawn for 4 years now. On occasion I have been away but never had to worry about them not showing up and still charging me ( as happened with someone else). Always leave everything nice and orderly.

reviews.author: Diane M
reviews.text: I called APL to have them come do a quote for my front lawn mulch beds- in front of the porch. Having just moved in, it's empty beds just waiting to be filled. I called APL after reading great reviews. Booked the appointment time for the following week. 2 hrs prior to the appointment, which was scheduled end of business day, I received a text message. A text, mind you, not a phone call, to tell me that APL was cancelling as they were short staffed and couldn't handle any more work. Not sure how they didn't know that the morning of? Or even a week prior at time of booking? Extending even a modicum of consideration goes a long way. Totally unprofessional, in every sense of the word. I'll be sure to let anyone I have opportunity to share this with know- APL is not the company you want to call. They can't handle their schedule- it's doubtful they candle handle your property.

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.text: Tony has been our landscaper for two years now. He and his team do a thorough job. We will miss them and their exceptional services as we are moving out of the area :(

reviews.author: Jared Carr
reviews.text: Tony and the APL guys did an amazing job on our spring clean up and even went as far as to help pick out all the new plants for our new mulch beds and lay it out perfectly. Couldn’t be more happier!

reviews.author: Mary Prior
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a lawn company/landscaper look no further! Tony and his crew do an excellent job. Professional and courteous! He takes pride in his work and it shows!!

reviews.author: Sw Vee
reviews.text: If I could I would give 10 stars. Tony and his crew did an awesome job with my landscaping and lawn couldn’t ask for more!

reviews.author: Joe Cox
reviews.text: Tony does a great job keeping my property clean and looking nice. Always shows up when he says he will be there.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Top notch crew. Owner really nice guy. Good to hire real Americans and not illegal immigrants who don't speak english.
